text: A new health zone is affected: Viadana (Bas-Uele), taking the footprint to 56 of 151 and Bas-Uele from 1 zone to 2 of 11. Viadana does not adjoin Buta, the province's first affected zone, and lies about 270 km from it; its neighbours are Isiro, Niangara and Rungu in Haut-Uele, two of them already affected, so this is a step across the Haut-Uele frontier rather than growth of a Buta cluster.
